about: A web app that helps bring bank and card data into Beancount, a plain-text accounting tool.

prs.title: Bank amounts with a comma decimal import at the right size
prs.broken: Some banks, French banks for example, write amounts like 34,51. These were imported 100 times too large, so -34,51 became -3451, with no warning.
prs.changed: A comma is now read as the decimal mark when the amount has no period. Amounts with a period are read as before.
prs.matters: Imported accounts show the real amounts and balances, not numbers off by a factor of 100.
